rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when artistic describes someone's creative talent.

example.english: They had artistic talent even as a child and were especially good at drawing.
example.traditional: 佢細個已經有藝術細胞，畫畫特別叻。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 jau5 ngai6 seot6 sai3 baau1 waa2 waa2 dak6 bit6 lek1

rows.note: Choose this when artistic means aesthetically appealing or having an artistic feel.

example.english: This mural has a very artistic feel.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 coeng4 waa2 hou2 jau5 ngai6 seot6 gam2

rows.note: Use this attributive phrase for something related to art, rather than praising someone's talent or aesthetic appeal.

example.english: I want to take a course in the artistic field.
example.traditional: 我想報讀藝術方面嘅課程。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 bou3 duk6 ngai6 seot6 fong1 min6 ge3 fo3 cing4
